title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): View SQL call information in performance profiles
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) adds SQL call visibility to performance profiles in both the in-client profiler and Visual Studio Code, enabling developers and consultants to diagnose whether performance issues stem from AL code or database queries without direct SQL access.
key_points: Performance profiles now display actual SQL calls made during profiling with query details visible on hover and copyable text
This enhancement helps identify if performance problems are due to inefficient AL code or problematic SQL queries
Scheduled profiles in the performance overview show total SQL call duration, number of calls, and platform call duration
Feature builds on earlier profiling capabilities added in BC19 (Visual Studio Code profiler), BC20 (in-client profiler), and BC24 (rule-based scheduling)
features: SQL call visibility in performance profiles

quotes.text: Understanding SQL performance when troubleshooting in the cloud without direct SQL access can be hard.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the business need that this feature addresses for cloud-based deployments
